name: cvposh
description: CVPosh is a resume and CV builder with an MCP server built for AI agents: your agent reads your saved CVs, scores them for ATS compatibility and compares them with a job posting, and you review and edit the result.
suggestedPrompts: List the CVs in my CVPosh account
Check my CV for ATS compatibility and tell me what to fix first
Compare my CV with this job posting and show the missing keywords
